{{Quote|I could go for one of those.''"<br />"''Yeah, me too.|Kyle Katarn and Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref>}}
'''Ruby bliel''' was a gooey, tasty drink that could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was known to have been available at several [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] on Tatooine, including [[Maggy the Gorgon's]] and the [[Blue Brubb]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] and stalls around Mos Espa. It was a favorite of young [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[W. Wald]] and [[Kitster Chanchani Banai]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> It was one of multiple drinks, alongside the [[galaxy guzzler]] and [[dusty dazzler]], that could be made using a mixture of liquidized [[Fruit/Legends|fruits]] and [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetables]], as well as [[Water/Legends|water]]. Its liquid form was meant to maximize liquid intake, as Tatooine's [[Binary star/Legends|twin]] [[Star/Legends|suns]]&mdash;[[Tatoo I/Legends|Tatoo I]] and [[Tatoo II/Legends|Tatoo II]]&mdash;gave the planet extreme [[Temperature/Legends|temperatures]].<ref name="FF131" /> The ruby bliel was [[Alcohol/Legends|non-alcoholic]].<ref name="Divided" />

It was also a popular drink in [[Baruk's Bar]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], generally recommended by the grammatically challenged [[Baldarek|Red-Eye Baldarek]]. [[Reelo Baruk]] himself may have been fond of the drink, as he used its name for the password to his secret command center within his garbage facility. Unfortunately for Baruk, [[Kyle Katarn]] was able to learn this code from an imprisoned [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], which soon led to Baruk's undoing.<ref name="Outcast" />
